parameters.content:
## Branch A - forward consensus

One Alpha Vantage `EARNINGS_CALENDAR` request returns the whole 3-month forward calendar (~1,612 rows). Free tier is **25 requests/day**; this uses **one**.

Reads the n8n variable **ALPHAVANTAGE_KEY**. If it is unset the branch logs a clear reason and stops - the keyless 8-K feed is untouched.

## Branch B - actual EPS, the one governed model call

EPS lives in free-text prose inside EX-99.1, and the exhibit filename is unpredictable. That is real judgement, so it gets a model - and the **only** one in this pipeline.

`iris_spend_check` runs BEFORE every call and **fails closed**; `iris_spend_record` books real token usage after. Bounded to 6 filings per run.

The exhibit is framed as untrusted data and the model reports any text addressed to an AI.
